_doc: OpenRouter free-layer model alias table. Dex-only PILOT. This is a PLUS draft tool next to Nyx (local Qwen2.5 on the GPU) and Codex -- it does NOT replace them and no default workflow switches to it. openrouter-draft.py resolves alias -> model id from here (store/openrouter-models.json overrides this seed if present). Free :free endpoints get deprecated/rate-limited -- before trusting an alias long-term, re-verify it against the OpenRouter Models API (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models). Rate limits are FLEET-wide, not per-agent: 20 req/min, 50 req/day under 10 USD credit.
